title: Blue Account features and fees
summary: This document outlines Blue Account features and fees: no overdraft fees from the account, a $20.00 monthly maintenance fee waived with a $625 minimum daily balance, and a $2.50/month paper statement fee. It also lists $12.50 overdraft protection transfer fees (if opted in) plus $15.00 returned deposit, $12.50 incoming domestic wire, and $30 stop payment fees, and APY boosts when linked to Silver Plus (+0.35%) or Platinum (+0.8%).
